reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that belief is not passive reception but active construction rooted in will. The psychological process begins with raw sensory input (thought), which must be interpreted through a framework of volition to become belief. This dualism between thought and reality is temporal—thoughts arise first, followed by their attribution to reality. The will-to-world is the foundational drive that transforms subjective experience into objective belief. In GSI, this manifests as Bayesian updating where prior belief is shaped by motivational weights. In GSE, belief transitions are modeled as state changes driven by internal motivation and external feedback. The failure mode occurs when the will-to-world is absent, leading to solipsism or epistemic collapse. The mathematical structure is thus a motivational vector field over belief space, where each belief update is a trajectory guided by volition and sensory evidence.
